name: AgentProof Trust Oracle
description: Autonomous reputation oracle for the ERC-8004 agent ecosystem. Indexes 100,000+ agents across 21 EVM chains, computes 10-signal composite trust scores with Bayesian smoothing, and publishes results on-chain. Queryable via REST API, Google A2A protocol, Anthropic MCP, and ENS resolution.

autonomousCapabilities.screen_new_agents: Discover and score newly registered ERC-8004 agents every 5 minutes
autonomousCapabilities.monitor_anomalies: Detect score volatility, concentrated feedback, and suspicious patterns every 15 minutes
autonomousCapabilities.verify_agent_liveness: Probe agent endpoints for uptime/latency every hour
autonomousCapabilities.publish_network_report: Generate aggregate network health reports every 6 hours
autonomousCapabilities.sync_github_activity: Poll GitHub for coding agent contribution metrics every 10 minutes
autonomousCapabilities.compute_failure_metrics: Calculate MTTR and failure rates every 30 minutes
autonomousCapabilities.push_scores_onchain: Write consensus scores to TrustScoreOracle contracts on-chain
